thread:
sophie: Quick ask for design: we need a condensed "Benchmark Snapshot" PDF (single page) to hand out at the webinar. Think: headline, 1 chart (latency vs cost ranges), 3 bullet recommendations, tiny routing mini-diagram, and a footnote with test config and date. Please make it print-friendly (A4) and web-optimized.

ben: Got it. Do you want exact numbers or illustrative ranges? Legal prefers hedged phrasing.

sophie: Keep it illustrative (bands/dots), but include a small table in the footer with the specific test configs for people who want detail. Footnote text: "Results observed using model X v1.2 on A100-equivalent hardware. Tested: 2026-03-10. Results will vary based on workload."

mike: Will use the new brand type scale. Any icon style?

sophie: Use the Redwood outline icons. Keep accents on the green for performance and amber for cost. Also add a small QR code linking to the webinar recording page.

brand-bot: Brand compliance checklist attached. Must include logo spacing, medallion placement, and legal footnote.

ben: ETA for draft: Mon 10am PT. Uploading a PDF and optimized PNGs for social.

sophie: Thanks  also ask design to include the hidden HubSpot fields suggestion so downloads map to campaign: performance_snapshot, lead_source: webinar_handout.
